server.name: papers-manager
principles: Humans and Agents use the same resources and revision rules.
No Agent identity, profile, or preference table is stored.
Tools return section IDs and content, never private storage keys or paths.
Evidence links and section descriptions are consumer-owned Markdown.

tools.name: papers_manager_application_info
tools.title: Get application Web address
tools.description: Return the configured client-visible web_base_url and library_url for Markdown report links. No input, database or file reads. Use library_url + ?doc=<UUID> or ?base=<UUID>; preserve the deployment path. Never infer the Web port from the MCP endpoint. web_available=false means this API-only deployment has no advertised Web URL; retain UUID references rather than asking the user for a port.

tools.name: papers_manager_library_search
tools.title: Search the paper library
tools.description: Search documents by title, filename, author, DOI, tags, or document ID. Returns bounded document and paper metadata; does not read paper contents.

query.description: Title, filename, author, or document ID fragment.

tools.name: papers_manager_library_get
tools.title: Read one document
tools.description: Read one document, its paper metadata, source state, and compact processing summary. Missing paper metadata is allowed.

tools.name: papers_manager_library_get_many
tools.title: Read multiple documents
tools.description: Read 1-200 documents and their paper metadata in one call. Use include_processing=true for stage state and reference progress. Results preserve the requested order; IDs that do not resolve are reported in missingDocumentIds. Duplicate IDs are deduplicated. Read-only.

document_ids.description: 1-200 document IDs. Duplicate IDs are deduplicated.

include_processing.description: Include the processing view for each document (default false).

tools.name: papers_manager_library_import_url
tools.title: Import a paper URL
tools.description: Queue explicit HTTP(S) paper URL downloads and return immediately with id/state/total. Poll papers_manager_library_import_status using the returned id. Accepted documents are added to base_id per item; PDF processing continues independently. Optional request_id is a UUID idempotency key: reuse it only with the identical request. Completed results are retained for 24 hours; BATCH_IMPORT_TIMEOUT bounds background acceptance, not this MCP call. Optional metadata is applied before parsing; importMetadata reports applied/skipped/failed independently of source acceptance. Only explicit processing.source_lookup=skip disables automatic catalog lookup.

base_id.description: Optional Base ID. When set, the imported document is added to this Base (idempotent).

request_id.description: Optional stable UUID for safely resubmitting the identical request after a lost response.

metadata.description: Optional imported bibliographic fields (camelCase). At most 64 KiB; provided fields are protected from automatic overwrites.

processing.description: Only explicit skip disables automatic source lookup. Parsing and reference extraction continue; manual catalog retry remains available.

duplicate_metadata.description: Existing-document metadata policy. Never changes saved processing options or restarts tasks. replace overwrites only supplied fields.

tools.name: papers_manager_library_import_file
tools.title: Import a local paper file
tools.description: Import one regular file from MCP_LOCAL_IMPORT_ROOT and start the normal processing pipeline. Local file import calls are bounded by MCP_IMPORT_CONCURRENCY (default 2 simultaneous calls, independent of the 20-item batch size); excess calls fail with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. Paths outside the configured root, including symlink escapes, are rejected. Disabled when MCP_LOCAL_IMPORT_ROOT is empty. Optionally adds the document to a Base via base_id. Optional metadata is applied before parsing; importMetadata reports applied/skipped/failed independently of source acceptance. Only explicit processing.source_lookup=skip disables automatic catalog lookup.

path.description: Absolute path, or a path relative to MCP_LOCAL_IMPORT_ROOT.

doi.description: Optional DOI to attach to the imported document.

base_id.description: Optional Base ID. When set, the imported document is added to this Base (idempotent).

metadata.description: Optional imported bibliographic fields (camelCase). At most 64 KiB; provided fields are protected from automatic overwrites.

processing.description: Only explicit skip disables automatic source lookup. Parsing and reference extraction continue; manual catalog retry remains available.

duplicate_metadata.description: Existing-document metadata policy. Never changes saved processing options or restarts tasks. replace overwrites only supplied fields.

tools.name: papers_manager_library_import_urls
tools.title: Import paper URLs in a batch
tools.description: Queue explicit HTTP(S) paper URL downloads and return immediately with id/state/total. Poll papers_manager_library_import_status using the returned id. Accepted documents are added to base_id per item; PDF processing continues independently. Optional request_id is a UUID idempotency key: reuse it only with the identical request. Completed results are retained for 24 hours; BATCH_IMPORT_TIMEOUT bounds background acceptance, not this MCP call. Optional options must align with paths/urls before any filtering. Each item may include metadata, processing.source_lookup, duplicate_metadata. Import results distinguish source acceptance and metadata application; parsing readiness is separate.

urls.description: 1-20 explicit HTTP(S) paper URLs downloaded sequentially in the background.

dois.description: Optional DOIs aligned by index with urls. Omit or provide exactly one entry per URL; an empty string means no DOI.

base_id.description: Optional Base ID. Each accepted or duplicate document is added to this Base (idempotent).

request_id.description: Optional stable UUID for safely resubmitting the identical request after a lost response.

metadata.description: Optional imported bibliographic fields (camelCase). At most 64 KiB; provided fields are protected from automatic overwrites.

processing.description: Only explicit skip disables automatic source lookup. Parsing and reference extraction continue; manual catalog retry remains available.

duplicate_metadata.description: Existing-document metadata policy. Never changes saved processing options or restarts tasks. replace overwrites only supplied fields.

options.description: Optional one options object per path/URL, in exactly the same order; use {} for defaults. At most 1 MiB for the request.

tools.name: papers_manager_library_import_status
tools.title: Get URL import progress
tools.description: Read queued/running/succeeded/partial/failed/stopped URL import state, per-item results and document IDs. Poll after submitting import_url/import_urls. Import completion is separate from PDF parsing; query processing_status for created documents. succeeded means every item was accepted or already existed; partial means mixed results; stopped means early termination. summary counts outcomes; retryUrls contains only failed/unprocessed inputs, preserving DOI/filename. Inspect result.items while running to discover accepted/duplicate document IDs incrementally; start notes once each document markdown succeeds, without waiting for the whole batch or metadata lookup. Results expire 24 hours after completion.

task_id.description: The id returned by import_url or import_urls.

tools.name: papers_manager_library_import_files
tools.title: Import local paper files in a batch
tools.description: Import 1-20 regular files from MCP_LOCAL_IMPORT_ROOT in one call and start the normal processing pipeline. All paths are validated before any import; items are then accepted sequentially with per-item results. Import calls share the MCP_IMPORT_CONCURRENCY gate (default 2 simultaneous calls); excess calls fail with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. Paths outside the configured root, including symlink escapes, are rejected. Disabled when MCP_LOCAL_IMPORT_ROOT is empty. Optionally adds each resulting document to a Base via base_id. Optional options must align with paths/urls before any filtering. Each item may include metadata, processing.source_lookup, duplicate_metadata. Import results distinguish source acceptance and metadata application; parsing readiness is separate.

paths.description: 1-20 paths, absolute or relative to MCP_LOCAL_IMPORT_ROOT. All paths must resolve inside the root.

dois.description: Optional DOIs aligned by index with paths. Omit or provide exactly one entry per file; an empty string means no DOI.

base_id.description: Optional Base ID. Each accepted or duplicate document is added to this Base (idempotent).

metadata.description: Optional imported bibliographic fields (camelCase). At most 64 KiB; provided fields are protected from automatic overwrites.

processing.description: Only explicit skip disables automatic source lookup. Parsing and reference extraction continue; manual catalog retry remains available.

duplicate_metadata.description: Existing-document metadata policy. Never changes saved processing options or restarts tasks. replace overwrites only supplied fields.

options.description: Optional one options object per path/URL, in exactly the same order; use {} for defaults. At most 1 MiB for the request.

tools.name: papers_manager_library_update_metadata
tools.title: Update document metadata
tools.description: Correct only explicitly requested document or paper metadata fields. Omitted fields are unchanged.

published_at.description: Publication date as YYYY-MM-DD or RFC3339. Omit to keep the current date.

tools.name: papers_manager_library_delete
tools.title: Delete one document
tools.description: Delete one document after explicit user confirmation. The caller must pass confirm=true; dependent notes, citations, and Base memberships are affected.

tools.name: papers_manager_processing_status
tools.title: Read document processing status
tools.description: Read the single processing projection for one document: stage states, active or terminal spans, safe errors, and reference progress. Includes readingReady (source available + markdown succeeded), workflowStatus, sourceLookupMode and retryTargets. Waiting includes not-started/manual stages; skipped is explicit, not failure. Generation and stage reasons remain authoritative.

tools.name: papers_manager_processing_status_many
tools.title: Read multiple document processing statuses
tools.description: Read processing projections for 1-200 documents in one call: stage states, active or terminal spans, safe errors, and reference progress. Results preserve the requested order; IDs that do not resolve are reported in missingDocumentIds. Duplicate IDs are deduplicated. Read-only. Includes readingReady (source available + markdown succeeded), workflowStatus, sourceLookupMode and retryTargets. Waiting includes not-started/manual stages; skipped is explicit, not failure. Generation and stage reasons remain authoritative. Aggregate status is processing/waiting/succeeded/partial/failed; summary includes missing IDs and readingReady count. This is document processing, not import acceptance.

document_ids.description: 1-200 document IDs. Duplicate IDs are deduplicated.

tools.name: papers_manager_processing_retry
tools.title: Retry document processing
tools.description: Retry one processing lane. auto delegates to the document service; markdown restarts recognition; extraction, catalog, and reference retry exactly one paper-information stage.

tools.name: papers_manager_processing_cancel
tools.title: Cancel document processing
tools.description: Cancel the markdown parse or paper-information lane. Cancelling one lane does not cancel the other.

tools.name: papers_manager_document_structure
tools.title: Read the source outline
tools.description: Read the persisted source outline, recognition generation, section page/bbox/block/Markdown hints, and diagnostics. Never infers an outline.

tools.name: papers_manager_document_read_section
tools.title: Read one source section
tools.description: Read a source section by ordinal. Default mode=markdown preserves the original section/markdown/diagnostics response (up to 4 MiB). Explicit mode=blocks returns paginated blocks including child sections; mode=range returns a half-open block_range without text, with optional paginated IDs via include_ids=true. Blocks/range return recognition_generation; use expected_generation across calls. Missing block mappings return UNAVAILABLE in blocks/range mode; Markdown mapping remains independent.

tools.name: papers_manager_document_read_markdown
tools.title: Read parsed Markdown
tools.description: Read bounded parsed Markdown with page count and recognition generation. Responses above the MCP limit fail with PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.

tools.name: papers_manager_document_read_blocks
tools.title: Read page-scoped Blocks
tools.description: Read source blocks by page, block_range, or up to 200 unique block_ids (mutually exclusive). New selectors/pagination return ordered, paginated items, generation, missing_ids and succeeded/partial/failed status. Pass expected_generation from a prior section/range read to reject stale IDs. Legacy document/page-only calls retain the original items response.

tools.name: papers_manager_document_read_block_image
tools.title: Read a Block image
tools.description: Return the parser-stored PNG crop for an image or table Block as an MCP image content block. The private storage key is never returned.

tools.name: papers_manager_document_read_page_image
tools.title: Read a PDF page image
tools.description: Render one full PDF page or normalized page region as a bounded PNG. This is a direct read, not an asynchronous processing task; the private storage key is never returned.

bbox.description: Normalized page rectangle in [0,1]; omit for the full page.

tools.name: papers_manager_reading_note_outline
tools.title: Read the reading-note outline
tools.description: Read the revisioned note directory and consumer-derived section descriptions. The adapter reads bounded section Markdown and parses section-meta; the backend does not expose descriptions.

tools.name: papers_manager_reading_note_read_section
tools.title: Read one note section
tools.description: Read one section body including its heading, section-meta block, line count, and current note revision. Large sections fail with PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.

tools.name: papers_manager_reading_note_create
tools.title: Create a reading note
tools.description: Create an absent reading note only. expected_revision must be 0; existing notes return REVISION_CONFLICT. The assigned per-document worker should write directly and return the saved revision and a compact summary, not a draft for another agent to save.

tools.name: papers_manager_reading_note_apply_edits
tools.title: Apply note edits
tools.description: Apply the existing revision-fenced semantic edit contract atomically. A stale expected_revision returns REVISION_CONFLICT; never auto-refresh and retry the same content.

old_text.description: replaceText only: exact text to find. Leave empty for other operations.

new_text.description: replaceText only: replacement text. Use content for append/insert/replaceRange.

content.description: replaceRange, insertAt, appendText, replaceSection, and addSection content. Not used by replaceText.

tools.name: papers_manager_reading_note_replace
tools.title: Replace a reading note
tools.description: Replace the entire reading note from Markdown, fenced by expected_revision. This is the whole-note import/replace path; use apply_edits for incremental changes.

tools.name: papers_manager_reading_note_delete
tools.title: Delete a reading note
tools.description: Delete the entire reading note at the expected revision. Requires explicit user confirmation.

tools.name: papers_manager_reading_note_export
tools.title: Export a reading note
tools.description: Return the full concatenated reading-note Markdown with its current revision. Responses larger than 16 MiB return PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.

tools.name: papers_manager_reading_note_replace_section
tools.title: Replace a note section
tools.description: Replace one whole note section with complete section Markdown, preserving its heading and level. Use apply_edits for smaller changes.

tools.name: papers_manager_evidence_validate
tools.title: Validate an evidence link
tools.description: Validate link/version/UUID syntax, normalized rectangles and recorded page bounds only. Never checks block/section existence, ownership, page membership or semantic support. range_checked=false means page bounds are unknown even if valid=true. Reads metadata only, not Markdown/PDF.

tools.name: papers_manager_evidence_validate_many
tools.title: Validate evidence links in a batch
tools.description: Validate 1–100 evidence links with the same lightweight rules as evidence_validate. Fetches all distinct documents’ page counts in one metadata query. Returns input indexes, per-item validations/errors, summary and succeeded/partial/failed status. Unknown page bounds are partial; malformed/out-of-range links and lookup errors are failed. Does not resolve blocks.

tools.name: papers_manager_base_list
tools.title: List Bases
tools.description: List named paper collections with bounded pagination.

tools.name: papers_manager_base_get
tools.title: Read a Base
tools.description: Read one Base and optionally its first/selected member page. Member listing uses the backend's fixed page size.

tools.name: papers_manager_base_list_documents
tools.title: List Base members
tools.description: List one page of members for a Base.

exclude_unknown.description: Only include documents with an available source file.

tools.name: papers_manager_base_reading_outlines
tools.title: Read source and notes outlines for a Base page
tools.description: Batch-read persisted source PDF/Markdown outlines and notes directories for Base members. outline_type selects source, notes or both. Uses batched database joins, never loads document bodies or section descriptions. Each item and the current page report succeeded/partial/failed; missing, not_ready, unavailable and error are separate part states. Valid empty outlines succeed, an empty Base succeeds, truncation is explicit via complete/total_sections. Page status covers only that page, not the entire Base; follow has_more. Notes revisions are metadata snapshots and do not prove section files are readable. Worker writes must still use a fresh revision.

tools.name: papers_manager_base_create
tools.title: Create a Base
tools.description: Create a named collection. This does not copy or modify documents.

tools.name: papers_manager_base_update
tools.title: Update a Base
tools.description: Rename a Base or change its description. Omitted fields are unchanged.

tools.name: papers_manager_base_delete
tools.title: Delete a Base
tools.description: Delete a collection and its memberships only; source documents are never deleted. Requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: papers_manager_base_add_document
tools.title: Add a document to a Base
tools.description: Add one existing document to a Base. Membership only.

tools.name: papers_manager_base_remove_document
tools.title: Remove a document from a Base
tools.description: Remove one membership. The source document and its notes are never deleted.

tools.name: papers_manager_base_bibliography_generate
tools.title: Generate a Base bibliography
tools.description: Queue a .bib snapshot export for a Base. Poll the returned task ID with base_bibliography_status.

tools.name: papers_manager_base_bibliography_status
tools.title: Read bibliography task status
tools.description: Read a Base bibliography generation task and its completed snapshot, if available.

tools.name: papers_manager_citation_list
tools.title: List citations
tools.description: List one document's outgoing bibliography rows, including unresolved references.

tools.name: papers_manager_citation_list_cited_by
tools.title: List citing papers
tools.description: List bibliography rows whose resolved target is this document.

tools.name: papers_manager_citation_add
tools.title: Add a citation
tools.description: Add one manual bibliography row. Optionally link it to a stored document.

tools.name: papers_manager_citation_replace
tools.title: Replace citations
tools.description: Replace a document's entire outgoing bibliography. This can remove manual rows; requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: papers_manager_citation_remove
tools.title: Remove a citation
tools.description: Delete one bibliography row by reference ID. Requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: papers_manager_citation_update_reference
tools.title: Edit a reference
tools.description: Correct one reference's bibliographic fields. Omitted fields are unchanged; empty values clear text fields. Resolution state is fenced by the service.

tools.name: papers_manager_citation_resolve
tools.title: Resolve a reference
tools.description: Manually link one reference row to an existing document.

tools.name: papers_manager_citation_rematch
tools.title: Rematch a reference locally
tools.description: Retry DOI/title matching against the current local library. No external provider is called.

tools.name: papers_manager_citation_download_pdf
tools.title: Download a reference PDF
tools.description: Queue acquisition of one reference's PDF from its trusted source URL. Success creates a new document and links the reference.
